_comment: OFF BY DEFAULT. The install never adds this. To turn the Stop arm on, merge the Stop entry into ~/.claude/settings.json yourself in a fresh session (never edit settings of a running session), register each lane with `work_loop.py lane add NAME`, and start each chat with HUBKIT_LANE=NAME. To pause it at any time: touch ~/.claude/hubkit/state/loop-pause. Remove the _comment key.
